default_realm.description: Default Kerberos realm and domain to use when no domain is explicitly specified in join commands.

kerberos_server.description: Preferred KDC or domain controller hostname (e.g., dc1.example.com). Optional; if omitted, DNS SRV records are used.

use_fully_qualified_names.description: If true, users and groups appear as 'user@realm' in the system; if false, just 'user' (short name).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 'debug', 'info', 'notice', 'warning', 'error', 'critical', or 'off'. Use 'debug' for troubleshooting.

automatic_imap.description: If true, automatically configure IMAP email settings using domain discovery (e.g., from SRV records).

automatic_ldap.description: If true, automatically configure LDAP/S directory service settings via domain discovery.

automatic_dns.description: If true, use DNS for domain controller discovery via SRV records; disable only in air-gapped networks.

computer_ou.description: Organizational Unit (DN) where computer accounts are created during enrollment (e.g., 'OU=Workstations,DC=example,DC=com').

os_name.description: Operating system name to report in the computer account (e.g., 'Ubuntu', 'RHEL', 'Fedora'.)

os_version.description: Operating system version to report (e.g., '38', '2023-05-01'). Often auto-detected.

disable_dns_sites.description: If true, disable site-aware DNS SRV queries (useful in non-AD or legacy DNS environments).

preferred_ad_site.description: Preferred Active Directory site name for domain controller selection (e.g., 'US-East').

discover.description: List of discovery mechanisms to enable: 'ldap', 'kerberos', 'srv'. Use empty list to disable automatic discovery.

kerberos_realm_mappings.description: List of Kerberos realm ↔ DNS domain mappings for non-standard or non-AD Kerberos realms.

name.description: Section name (must be unique per mapping; typically the DNS domain in lowercase).

domains.description: List of per-domain configuration overrides (e.g., for multi-domain forests or trusted domains).

member_of.description: Parent domain for nested domain enrollments (e.g., 'EXAMPLE.COM').

kerberos_server.description: Override KDC hostname specifically for this domain.

preferred_ad_site.description: Override AD site preference for this domain.
